messages.subject: WHA Corporation | Industrial estates, utilities and investor-stakeholder execution
messages.body:
Dear WHA Corporation Leadership Team,

WHA's integrated model across industrial estates, logistics, utilities, power and digital infrastructure creates a strong match with my experience coordinating government, investors, communities and operating teams around complex industrial priorities.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. I lead senior engagement across regulators, ministries, communities and strategic partners while coordinating delivery across technical and corporate functions.

My recent experience includes stakeholder and governance support around a large solar and battery-storage platform, carbon-data readiness, multi-agency approvals and social-performance priorities. I understand the institutional requirements behind industrial investment and the importance of creating clear ownership for permits, commitments, evidence and stakeholder concerns.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand, EEC or regional mandates in Government Relations, Corporate Affairs, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Investor Stakeholder Relations or Country Strategy. I have attached a WHA-focused executive CV and would appreciate your sharing it with the relevant executive leadership team.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
